before: A room kept every item for its whole life: a rejected insertion, an accepted deletion and a taken back word stayed in the list, hidden, and only a fold dropped them as a side effect. A place in a unit that a load never made, in a loaded paragraph, was refused as not-covered.
after: A close can call compactOrdered before it saves: it removes each item that no change can show again and that nothing reads, ends the undo of own edits, and keeps every suggestion. The cards, the Word file and each decision stay the same. A place in a removed unit is refused as unknown-address.
reason: Change messages, the change log, the manifest and the Word file do not change. Only the room's item list after a close is smaller, and every client opens the room's file after a close, so all copies hold the same list. Nothing calls the cleanup until the close path does.
